items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: The interviewee discusses Sidney Bechet's performance capabilities and historical timeline ('Sidney himself could not play qualifiedly...', 'Sidney Bechet was over there about the time of the war, too') but provides no evidence of a personal interaction, collaboration, or direct relationship with Be

ctx.x: And they might have introduced a sort of a modern aspect of a little ragtime with an interruption by him. But Sidney himself could not play qualifiedly in William Marion Cook's band at that time. No, he wasn't a good band.
